dimension.scope: The executed smooth hyperelliptic cover has genus three, hence its Jacobian has dimension three.

group_order.scope: The image generator is nonidentity and killed by the pinned prime r, proving exact order r for the transported cyclic image; this does not determine the full Jacobian order.

frobenius_or_weil_polynomial.scope: No full genus-three Weil polynomial is needed for the proved image order, and none is claimed.

field_of_definition.scope: The cover, map, pullbacks, exceptional fibers, and Mumford arithmetic execute over the same pinned GF(2^83) basis.

riemann_hurwitz_or_different.scope: The cover certificate replays separability, degree three, genus, and total ramification.

polarization_or_jacobian_locus.scope: The destination is the Jacobian of the explicitly constructed smooth curve C_0, not an assumed generic abelian threefold.

existence.scope: The exact pinned source, cover, Jacobian arithmetic, and image classes execute.

explicit_construction.scope: Equations, field basis, map, generator, target, pullback classes, and source recovery are explicit.

map_correctness.scope: Typed pull/push certificates verify phi_*phi^*=[3] on P, Q, infinity, and the exceptional rational two-torsion fiber.

subgroup_preservation.scope: The image of P is nonzero with exact prime order r, gcd(3,r)=1, and 3^-1 mod r is recorded.

scalar_recovery.scope: Destination solvers receive no planted scalar; recovered scalars verify in the Jacobian image and independently as [k]P=Q on the source.

destination_solver_applicability.scope: Named generic BSGS and three-partition rho adapters operate on actual pulled-back Mumford classes, not a source-group proxy.

computational_advantage.scope: The destination methods are generic, native Cantor work lacks a source-GAE conversion, and the L0 wall observations show no net win.

scaling_support.scope: All arms verified and replayed at four faithful successful sizes n=9,13,19,23; the preregistered n=7 source-reference exhaustion is retained.

novelty_within_boundary.scope: The cover is an existing construction and the attached BSGS/rho algorithms are standard generic solvers.
